speaker: Andrea Muñoz Spannaus
role: Second Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency
title: God Is at Your Side
summary: Sister Muñoz Spannaus teaches young women that Heavenly Father knows exactly where they are, loves them completely, and will guide them toward the righteous desires of their hearts. She tells of a GPS that misread her location until her husband guided her by phone, of Jesus loving the rich young man before He counseled him, and of a priesthood blessing that lifted her when she was learning English. She asks each young woman to choose one of seven practices, such as daily repentance, protecting sleep, and limiting phone use, and to write her own list of aspirations from the thirteenth article of faith.

findings.quote: Our Heavenly Father invites all of us to assist in His work of bringing to pass the eternal life of His children (see Moses 1:39; General Handbook: Serving in The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, 1.2, Gospel Library). He also blesses us with specific responsibilities within His work. President Dieter F. Uchtdorf explained: “The Lord gave you your responsibilities for a reason. There may be people and hearts only you can reach and touch. Perhaps no one else could do it in quite the same way” (“Lift Where You Stand,” Liahona, Nov. 2008, 56).
